using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Dict = System.Collections.Generic.Dictionary<string, int>;
using Alias = Geometry.Core;
using static System.Math;
global using Geometry.Core;

namespace Geometry.Shapes
{
    /// <summary>A shape.</summary>
    /// <remarks>XML doc comments are not read.</remarks>
    [Serializable]
    [Obsolete("use IShape2")]
    public abstract class Shape : IShape, IComparable<Shape>
    {
        protected internal readonly string _name;
        private static int _count = 0, _other;
        public const double Tau = 2 * PI;
        private Owner? _owner;
        private List<Owner> _owners = new List<Owner>();
        private Nullable<int> _maybe;
        private (int, string) _pair;
        private int[] _numbers;
        private Owner[] _ownerArray;

        protected Shape(string name) : this(name, 0) { }
        protected Shape(string name, int id) { _name = name; Registry.Add(this); }

        public abstract double Area();
        public virtual double Perimeter() => 0;
        public override string ToString() => $"{_name}: {Area()}";
        public int CompareTo(Shape? other) => Area().CompareTo(other?.Area() ?? 0);
        public void Attach(Owner owner) { _owner = owner; owner.Notify(this); _owner.Ping(); }
        public void Attach(Owner owner, int priority) { _owners.Add(owner); }
    }

    public sealed class Circle : Shape
    {
        public double Radius { get; init; }
        public Circle(double r) : base("circle") { Radius = r; }
        public override double Area() => PI * Radius * Radius;
        public override double Perimeter() { return Tau * Radius; }
        ~Circle() { Console.WriteLine("bye"); }
    }

    public class Square : Shape, IDisposable
    {
        public Square() : base("square") { var c = new Circle(1); Helper.Run(c); }
        public override double Area() => 1;
        public void Dispose() { }
    }
}
